Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1871 (Androgen receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, target type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax ID 9606, standard type IC50, standard relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order rows by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to 1000 rows.
